name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature, layer, or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

---

## What problem does this solve?
A clear description of the use case or gap.

## Proposed solution
What you'd like to see happen. If this is a new environmental data layer,
note the data source and whether it's a continuous field (heatmap) or
discrete events (markers) — see CONTRIBUTING.md for the layer recipe.

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context
Mockups, links to similar implementations (e.g. Windy.com), or related issues.
